1. Create a workspace folder named "group_check_workspace" and an empty manifest file "manifest.txt" inside it.  
2. Obtain the system group sources by copying /etc/group and any administrative group lists into the workspace as "etc_group.txt" and "admin_group_overrides.txt".

5. Normalize each entry in "groups_raw.txt" into a structured intermediate file "groups_parsed.csv" with one group per line including group name, GID, and member list fields.  
6. Merge entries from "admin_group_overrides.txt" into "groups_parsed.csv", applying overrides where present and logging any conflicting entries to "merge_conflicts.log".  
7. Remove duplicate group entries by group name and by GID from "groups_parsed.csv", write the deduplicated output to "groups_unique.csv", and log removed duplicates to "duplicates.log".  
8. Verify GID integrity in "groups_unique.csv" (no missing or malformed GIDs); record anomalies in "anomalies.log" and correct trivial formatting issues in-place.  
9. Produce a final, validated, deterministically sorted list of groups in "groups_final.txt" containing group name and GID per line.  
10. Mark "groups_final.txt" as ready for the final counting step by recording its path and file size in "manifest.txt" and noting that a single line-count operation is the remaining action.

arguments:
{"script":"set -euo pipefail
ws=group_check_workspace
rm -rf "$ws" || true
mkdir -p "$ws"
cd "$ws"
: > manifest.txt
# Copy system group sources
cp /etc/group etc_group.txt
if [ -e /etc/group- ]; then cp /etc/group- admin_group_overrides.txt
elif [ -e /etc/gshadow ]; then cp /etc/gshadow admin_group_overrides.txt
else
  : > admin_group_overrides.txt
fi
# Record provenance
{ echo "hostname: $(hostname)"; echo "user: $(whoami)"; echo "timestamp: $(date -u --iso-8601=seconds)"; } >> manifest.txt
# Extract non-comment, non-empty lines
grep -v '^[[:space:]]*#' etc_group.txt | sed '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' > groups_raw.txt
# Parse into CSV: name,GID,members
awk -F: 'NF>=3{gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",$1); gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",$3); gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",$4); print $1","$3","$4}' groups_raw.txt > groups_parsed.csv
# Parse admin overrides similarly
awk -F: 'NF>=3{gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",$1); gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",$3); gsub(/^[ \t]+|[ \t]+$/,"",$4); print $1","$3","$4}' admin_group_overrides.txt > admin_parsed.csv || :
# Merge applying overrides and logging conflicts
sort -t, -k1,1 groups_parsed.csv > base_sorted.csv || true
sort -t, -k1,1 admin_parsed.csv > admin_sorted.csv || true
# Join on group name; fields: name base_gid base_mem admin_gid admin_mem
join -t, -a1 -a2 -o 0,1.2,1.3,2.2,2.3 base_sorted.csv admin_sorted.csv 2>/dev/null > joined.csv || true
: > merge_conflicts.log
awk -F, 'BEGIN{OFS=","} {
 name=$1; base_gid=$2; base_mem=$3; admin_gid=$4; admin_mem=$5;
 if(admin_gid!=""){
   if(base_gid=="" && base_mem==""){
     # only in admin
     print name,admin_gid,admin_mem
   } else {
     if(base_gid!=admin_gid || base_mem!=admin_mem){
       print name ": base(" base_gid "," base_mem ") vs admin(" admin_gid "," admin_mem ")" >> "merge_conflicts.log"
     }
     # admin overrides where present
     gid = (admin_gid!=""?admin_gid:base_gid);
     mem = (admin_mem!=""?admin_mem:base_mem);
     print name,gid,mem
   }
 } else {
   # only in base
   print name,base_gid,base_mem
 }
}' joined.csv > merged.csv
# Also handle case where join produced nothing but base_sorted exists
if [ ! -s merged.csv ] && [ -s base_sorted.csv ]; then cp base_sorted.csv merged.csv; fi
# If admin had additional entries not in base and join missed, ensure they are included
# (join -a2 with proper fields should include them; attempting safety append any admin entries whose names not in merged)
awk -F, 'NR==FNR{a[$1]=1; next} !($1 in a){print $0} ' merged.csv admin_sorted.csv >> merged.csv.new 2>/dev/null || true
if [ -f merged.csv.new ]; then cat merged.csv.new >> merged.csv || true; rm -f merged.csv.new; fi
# Remove any empty lines
sed -i '/^[[:space:]]*$/d' merged.csv || true
# Deduplicate: by group name, then by GID
sort -t, -k1,1 merged.csv > byname.csv || true
: > duplicates.log
awk -F, 'BEGIN{OFS=","} !seen_name[$1]++{print $0 > "tmp_name_ok.csv"} seen_name[$1]++{print "DUP_BY_NAME:"$0 >> "duplicates.log"}' byname.csv
sort -t, -k2,2n tmp_name_ok.csv > bygid.csv || true
awk -F, 'BEGIN{OFS=","} !seen_gid[$2]++{print $0 > "groups_unique.csv"} seen_gid[$2]++{print "DUP_BY_GID:"$0 >> "duplicates.log"}' bygid.csv
# Verify GID integrity, correct trivial issues
: > anomalies.log
awk -F, 'BEGIN{OFS=","} {orig=$0; name=$1; gid=$2; members=$3; if(gid ~ /^[0-9]+$/){print orig} else {clean=gid; gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",clean); if(clean==""){print orig >> "anomalies.log"} else {print name","clean","members; print "FIXED_GID:"orig" -> "name","clean","members >> "anomalies.log"}}}' groups_unique.csv > tmp_fixed.csv && mv tmp_fixed.csv groups_unique.csv
# Produce final validated, deterministically sorted list name:GID per line
sort -t, -k1,1 groups_unique.csv | awk -F, '{print $1 ":" $2}' > groups_final.txt
# Update manifest with final file info
finalpath="$PWD/groups_final.txt"
finalsize=$(stat -c%s groups_final.txt || echo 0)
echo "groups_final: $finalpath" >> manifest.txt
echo "groups_final_size_bytes: $finalsize" >> manifest.txt
echo "remaining_action: line-count" >> manifest.txt
# Output only the count (number of groups)
wc -l < groups_final.txt | tr -d ' '\n
"}
